pages.text: The rumblepea is a temperamental crop that must be handled with care. Its delicate root system attracts bacteria that can boost nearby crop growth. The rumblepea produces a highly explosive substance that it uses to deter predators and trampling.

While the rumblepea lacks a distinct flavour it has a feint smell of rotten eggs when freshly picked. Eating the fruit will release a gust of steam that may toggle certain blocks like redstone components.
The fruit can be processed into more seeds.
The seeds can be processed into gunpowder.
